Before a chicken share fills a freezer, it looks a lot like this. 🐔

Three kids, a barn full of young birds, and a New York farm family caring for the flock together.

Roswell Family Farm began by raising food for our own freezer. Today, our Chicken Shares help other families plan ahead, choose their processing, and know more about where their food comes from.

Chicken Share pricing:

• 5–19 chickens: $16.00 per bird
• 20–39 chickens: $15.50 per bird
• 40+ chickens: $15.00 per bird

Choose whole birds at no additional processing charge, halved for an additional $3.50 per bird, or fully cut for an additional $7.00 per bird.

Follow Roswell Family Farm to watch the flock grow and get honest Upstate New York farm updates and family meal ideas.

Reserve your Chicken Share:
https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/chicken-share.html

Online reservations require a 50% reservation payment. A separate online reservation and administrative fee is shown at checkout and applies only when ordering online. Complete terms are provided on the order page.

#RoswellFamilyFarm #ChickenShares #PastureRaisedChicken #UpstateNYFarm #NewYorkFarm #mohawkvalley

26 THANKSGIVING TURKEYS REMAIN 🦃

Thanksgiving dinner starts months before the table is set. Here at Roswell Family Farm, we’re raising pasture-raised turkeys in Salisbury, New York, for local families who want to know where their holiday meal comes from.

🦃 $5.00/lb based on actual processed weight
✅ Processing included
⚖️ Expected processed weight of 20 pounds or more—weights vary and are not guaranteed
📅 Processing: November 23, 2026
📦 Expected pickup: November 24 or 25, 2026

Online reservation details: An $11 nonrefundable reservation payment is collected when ordering online. Of that amount, $10 is credited toward your final turkey balance and $1 is an online reservation and administrative fee. The $1 fee applies only to online orders.

Reserve through our website’s Turkey Preorders page:

https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/turkey-orders.html

From our Upstate New York farm to your Thanksgiving table—Abducted by Flavor. 🛸

#RoswellFamilyFarm #ThanksgivingTurkey #PastureRaisedTurkey #UpstateNY #NewYorkFarm

🛸 WEBSITE TRANSMISSION: OUR ONLINE ORDERING SYSTEM JUST GOT A MAJOR UPGRADE!

We’ve launched brand-new online preorder forms for both whole and half hogs and Thanksgiving turkeys!

🐷 HOG PREORDERS

• Whole hog — $4.00/lb hanging weight
• Half hog — $4.50/lb hanging weight
• USDA-inspected and custom-processing options available
• Secure online reservation payments
• Choose one half hog or reserve multiple whole hogs

The final farm balance is based on the official hanging weight reported by the processor. Butcher and processing charges are paid separately to the processor.

🦃 THANKSGIVING TURKEY PREORDERS

• $5.00/lb based on actual processed weight
• Processing included
• Expected weight of 20 pounds or more
• Processing scheduled for November 23, 2026
• Expected pickup November 24 or 25, 2026
• $11 non-refundable reservation payment per turkey
• Only 26 turkeys remain available

You can now read the complete details, select your quantity, sign the required agreement, and submit your reservation payment online through PayPal or Venmo.

Visit RoswellFamilyFarm.com and select Hog Preorders or Turkey Preorders to reserve yours.

Our updated system is designed to make ordering clearer, faster, and easier from your phone, tablet, or computer.

📱 Having trouble with the Turkey order form? If the embedded form does not load, tap the **“Open Turkey Order Form in a New Window”** button on the Turkey Preorders page to open it directly.

Thank you for supporting our farm family and local agriculture! The reservation signals are officially live. 🐷🦃🛸
